title: Agent Session List (v2)
description: Envelope returned by GET /api/v2/sessions (SPEC-022 R-1): the caller's sessions, most-recently-active first, capped server-side. SPEC-056 R-1/R-2 add the additive session_type discriminator on each row, which is also the additive query filter that scopes each portal entry to its own type.

session_type.description: SPEC-056 R-1: the session's birth type, immutable thereafter. Carried on the list row so Chat lists only 'operation' sessions and Studio only 'development' ones (R-2/OQ-3), and so the shift-summary picker can be scoped server-side to operational work (R-4).

title.description: Server-minted title (first user turn, capped at 80 characters); null for sessions created before SPEC-022.

pending_confirmation.description: True while the session holds an unresolved parked HITL confirmation.
